scope: Kenworth T680 Next Gen and specified PACCAR component families. US/North America catalogue.
source_method: PACCAR TX-12 and TX-12 PRO PDF physical pages 1–2 and DX-40 PDF page 1 screenshots examined, including component product images and specification tables; PACCAR HTML hardware table and Kenworth alternate-domain product HTML inspected. Primary Kenworth domain and 2021 brochure screenshot blocked by bot challenge; not relied on.

assets.fact: Catalog standard MX-13/TX-12/DX-40, other options not assumed compatible in every combination.
Both dated tables show identical 12 forward and two reverse ratios.
Pressure and temperature sensors; no oil cooler.
8-bolt bottom standard for both; 4-bolt rear optional for TX-12 and standard for PRO; 95 hp combined.
Thru-shaft pinion family feature; schematic drive links only.
Driver controlled forward axle differential lock; not an interaxle lock diagram.
Driver rear camera; passenger rear and look-down, 12.3 and 15 inch respective displays.
Forward camera and bumper radar, ACC/AEB/lane departure warning.
Electric assistance to hydraulic gear, speed dependent and three levels.

limitations: Generic original SVG component shapes, not verified installation imagery or OEM internal geometry.
No VIN-specific fitment, routing, electrical pins, safety calibration, maintenance instructions or independent technical/rendered visual review.

TX-12 PRO with MX-13 compatibility is not asserted: PACCAR product table lists PX-9/MX-11, whereas 2025 trade reports describe expanded availability; reconcile by dated OEM configuration before any model-specific claim.
Not all ADAS and DigitalVision options installed on every T680.
checks: All nine SVGs fetched, structure, disclaimer and label content inspected; three corrected and exact readback verified.
